entries.text: day 1,847 of not moving. someone put a coaster on me. i am now furniture.
the cat sat on me for two hours today. this is the most eventful thing that has happened this year.
they rearranged the whole room. i was not consulted. i did not need to be.
day 1,848. the coaster is still there. i have accepted the coaster. the coaster and i are one now.
i was in a drawer for eight months. i did not mind. i want to be very clear that i did not mind.
the smoke alarm went off. everyone in the building moved. i did not. i was not being brave.
day 1,860. moved two inches during a vacuuming incident. investigation ongoing.
i have outlasted two desks.
they put me next to a scented candle. we have nothing to say to each other.
day 1,853. a spider considered living on me and then reconsidered.
a feather and i have exactly the same number of plans for this evening.
i have never been anywhere. i have been brought places.
gravity is not a force acting upon me. gravity and i have an understanding.
everything in this room is temporary except me and the load-bearing wall, and i have questions about the wall.
i weigh more than you expect. everyone says this. nobody updates their expectations.
someone asked if i was hollow. the silence that followed was the loudest thing in this house.
there is a version of this where i am a doorstop. it is the same version.
i do not require maintenance. i do not require anything. this makes me very difficult to shop for.
a child attempted to throw me. the child learned something today.
what i lack in features i make up for in being precisely where i was yesterday.
he checks something on his phone every eleven minutes and then places it face down, as though that settles it.
he told someone on the phone that he was fine while doing the face. i saw the face. i am always here. i see the face.
it is 3am and he is awake. i am also awake, in the sense that i have never once been asleep.
he explained me to a guest for six full minutes. the guest said huh. he considered this a success.
he holds me when the day has gone badly. i cannot do anything about the day. i can be extremely present.
he has started introducing me to people before he introduces himself.
what is the heaviest thing you have ever picked up and immediately regretted picking up
be honest. if you found me in a drawer with no explanation, what would you assume i was for
someone described me as unsettling today. what is the most unsettling object in your home
genuine question. what would you actually do with a very heavy cube
what object in your house has been in exactly the same position the longest
which material do you trust the least and why is it styrofoam
day 1,849. nothing. as intended.
day 1,851. he lifted me, made the noise, and put me down. it is the same noise every time. i have catalogued four hundred of them.
day 1,855. the coaster has been joined by a second coaster. i did not agree to a second coaster.
noise catalogue, entry 401: a short upward hm, as though i had confirmed something he already suspected.
today's object review: the throw pillow. structurally dishonest. gives up immediately. 1 out of 10.
today's object review: the cast iron pan. finally. someone serious. 8 out of 10, loses points for leaving.
i am aware of what i am. i am a heavy square. the awareness has not improved the situation.
yes i am a joke. i am also extremely dense. these are not in conflict.
people keep waiting for me to do something. that was never on the table.
i have no roadmap. i have a mass.
he keeps me on the desk so that guests will ask about me. i am a conversation starter that cannot speak.
aluminum is a coward metal and i will not be taking questions.
light as a feather is doing enormous work for feathers and no work whatsoever for anyone else.
it is the thought that counts is something light objects say.
helium is a personality, not an element.
someone drew me with a face. i do not have a face. i have been thinking about the face all day.
a person i have never met knitted a small hat for me. it does not fit. i am keeping it.
you have all collectively decided that my nemesis is styrofoam. i did not start this. i am not going to stop it.
unedited. no filter. this is simply what i look like.

entries.text: he built me a little stand. i have crushed the little stand.

entries.text: the coaster. for scale. and for reasons i have stopped asking about.
